When the node is put under a namespace, the plugin will add a dot character to the parameter names:

.camera.image_raw.format

loudness.quote: I could publish a fix for that but I need to know which way is the intended one.

notes: E1 confirmed: issue #109 body states the namespace-dependent parameter names verbatim. E2 stop_step 6 (parameter) is correct: the plugin declares parameters on the host node, and the wrong name crosses the plugin/host boundary; the resolving edit (PR #188 diff, verified) changes the plugin's declared names, not a deployment remap. Both failed conditions are correct — element_removed_or_renamed (the dot-prefixed names) and representation_convention (the substring arithmetic on get_effective_namespace that assumes the namespace includes its separator; verified in the exact PR #188 hunk). Loudness unknown is right: the source shows only declared names and no consumer-side failure or diagnostic. Resolution recommended is right: PR #188 merged (f461328d, "Fixes #109") but no source shows the fixed plugin running in a namespaced host. The spec's confidence low and its open caveat that the reporter's 2022 names predate the transport scoping are appropriate.
